title: The derived identity at a localized complex
statement: Let C be an abelian category with its derived category, F an additive exact endofunctor, a:F≅Id, and K a cochain complex. The derived comparison induced by a, followed by the derived identity-functor comparison, evaluated on Q(K), is the factor comparison F_D(QK)→Q(F_complex K) followed by Q of the degreewise a comparison to K.

source.place: Steps 1 and 5: identity and composition of the normalized quotient, Roos-limit and tensor transport.

proof.text: Evaluate mapDerivedCategoryIdIso_factorsh at the image of K in the homotopy category, simplify the factor and complex-identity maps, and obtain the factor formula for the derived identity. Substitute this formula into mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac; the remaining complex identity component is identity, and the right identity law finishes. These are existing proved declarations in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.DerivedCategory.ExactFunctor.

theorem podIdentityDerivedFactors
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory C]
    (F : C ⥤ C) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (a : F ≅ 𝟭 C) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso a ≪≫ Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso C).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) =
      F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex a (.up ℤ) ≪≫
          Functor.mapHomologicalComplexIdIso C (.up ℤ)).hom.app K)
